# SCOTUSblog

> SCOTUSblog is the leading independent source for Supreme Court news, case analysis, and comprehensive coverage of pending and decided cases with expert legal commentary.

SCOTUSblog provides real-time tracking of Supreme Court dockets, oral arguments, and decisions across constitutional law, voting rights, immigration, and presidential power. The site features detailed case files, expert analysis from prominent legal scholars, and a newsfeed of breaking Supreme Court developments.

## Key Topics

- Supreme Court
- Constitutional Law
- Certiorari Petitions
- Oral Arguments
- Presidential Power
- Voting Rights & Redistricting
- Immigration Law
- Birthright Citizenship
- 14th Amendment
- Second Amendment
- Temporary Protected Status
- Independent Agencies
- Emergency Applications
- Legal Analysis

## Supreme Court Dockets & Terms

- [October Term 2025](https://www.scotusblog.com/case-files/terms/ot2025): Supreme Court October Term 2025 docket with case tracker and oral arguments
- [Emergency Docket 2025-26](https://www.scotusblog.com/case-files/emergency/emergency-docket-2025): Supreme Court emergency docket tracker for interim relief and stay applications
- [Supreme Court Petitions](https://www.scotusblog.com/case-files/petitions-were-watching): Comprehensive tracker of Supreme Court certiorari petitions and pending cases

## Major Cases & Constitutional Issues

- [Trump v. Barbara (Birthright Citizenship)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/trump-v-barbara): Supreme Court case on birthright citizenship and 14th Amendment interpretation
- [Trump v. Slaughter (Independent Agencies)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/trump-v-slaughter-2): Supreme Court case on presidential firing power and independent agency protections
- [Trump v. Cook (Presidential Removal Power)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/trump-v-cook): Supreme Court case on presidential removal power and Federal Reserve independence
- [Louisiana v. Callais (Voting Rights Act)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/louisiana-v-callais-2): Supreme Court case on Voting Rights Act and race-based redistricting
- [Abbott v. League of United Latin American Citizens (Texas Redistricting)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/abbott-v-league-of-united-latin-american-citizens): Supreme Court case on Texas redistricting and voting rights

## Immigration & Regulatory Cases

- [Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump (Tariffs)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/learning-resources-inc-v-trump): Supreme Court case file on Learning Resources v. Trump tariffs dispute
- [Trump v. Miot (Temporary Protected Status)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/trump-v-lesly-miot): Supreme Court case on Temporary Protected Status and immigration law
- [Noem v. Doe (Temporary Protected Status)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/noem-v-doe-2): Supreme Court case on Temporary Protected Status for Syrian nationals

## Pending Petitions & Emergency Applications

- [Tangipa v. Newsom (California Redistricting)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/tangipa-v-newsom): Supreme Court emergency application on California redistricting and gerrymandering
- [Trump v. Carroll (Evidence Rules)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/trump-v-carroll): Supreme Court petition on evidence rules and sexual assault allegations
- [Bannon v. United States (Congressional Subpoena)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/bannon-v-united-states-2): Supreme Court petition on congressional subpoena and contempt of Congress
- [Foote v. Ludlow School Committee (Parental Rights)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/foote-v-ludlow-school-committee): Supreme Court petition on parental rights and school gender transition policies

## Second Amendment Cases

- [Viramontes v. Cook County (AR-15 Regulations)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/viramontes-v-cook-county): Supreme Court petition on Second Amendment and AR-15 rifle regulations
- [Schoenthal v. Raoul (Illinois Gun Law)](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/case-files/schoenthal-v-raoul): Supreme Court petition on Second Amendment and Illinois gun law
